description:
Hi! I’m MAGANDA CAESER, an Environmental Science, Technology, and Management specialist in Kampala. I bring skills in environmental data analysis, and project management, and I’m passionate about climate resilience and Earth observation.

We’re tackling  Field SHIFT: Adapting Farms With NASA Data using NASA data to build a real-world solution. Looking for teammates skilled in coding, data science, or UI/UX design.
